title: Olive and the Race Home
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 1, week 3 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell u, c, g, ch
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.

pages.text: Olive and Pip stand at the start.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Pip the sparrow standing side by side at a marked starting point on the grass.

pages.text: Olive and Pip race to the nest.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Pip the sparrow racing across the garden towards a tall tree with a nest.

pages.text: Pip spots Nell stuck in a web.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow, mid-race, spotting Nell the bee caught in a spider web on a low bush.

pages.text: Pip stops the race to help Nell.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow stopping and turning towards the bush, wings out, heading to help Nell.

pages.text: Olive flies on, fast and free.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying on alone, fast and clear of the trees, well ahead now.

pages.text: Olive gets to the nest first.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl landing proudly at the nest, first to arrive.

pages.text: But Pip and Nell are not there yet.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl at the nest, looking back down the garden, no sign of Pip or Nell yet.

pages.text: Olive thinks about the race again.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl sitting at the nest, looking thoughtful, glancing back towards the bush.

pages.text: Olive flies back to help pull the web.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying back to the bush and helping Pip gently pull apart the sticky web around Nell.

pages.text: A race is not as good as a friend.
pages.illustration: Olive, Pip and Nell together at the bush, Nell free of the web, all three looking glad.
